schema_note: Supplemental, SEPARATE overlay of historical-candidate facility locations for S03 establishments that are ABSENT from the FSIS MPI Directory (active + inactive). This file is NOT the official MPI geocode cache (data/external/facility_geocode.json) and never overwrites it. Each entry is keyed on the S03 numeric establishment_id. The numeric establishment_id is NOT asserted to equal the historical USDA inspection number; the link is an external-research heuristic (name + state + address), confidence 'probable', and is NOT verified against any FSIS establishment id (verified_against_fsis_id=false). Coordinates are present ONLY when obtained from a reputable source and recorded with coordinate_source; a null lat/lon means no pin is drawn (candidate listed as metadata only). Never fabricate or estimate coordinates.
